soldier: Head pale yellow, mandibles reddish brown, pilosity of the head capsule sparse. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.60–0.63, lateral margins nearly parallel, the posterior part slightly widened, posterior margin slightly projecting. Frontal peaks slightly raised, with a slight depression between them. Labrum sharply lanceolate, the semi-transparent area at its tip shortly needle-like; apical setae present, subapical setae distinct, lateral apical setae absent. Mandibles slightly straight, apex slightly curved; mandible length 0.55–0.57 times head capsule length and 0.90–0.93 times head width. Antennae 15–16 segments. Broad region of the postmentum at the anterior sixth; anterior lateral margins nearly trapezoidal and widening posteriorly, the middle section slightly concave; waist region narrow and long, margins parallel, waist constriction index 0.29–0.33. Pronotum trapezoidal, about 1.63–1.68 times as wide as long, anterior and posterior margins nearly straight, the incisions at the middle of both margins nearly equal; 4–6 setae in the middle region.
